description:
Convert Chinese text where you work on iPhone and iPad. Import a UTF-8 TXT file from Files or paste text, choose a preset, and compare the source with the converted result. On iPad, place the two panes side by side or stack them to suit your workspace. Text conversion runs locally on your device.

Choose Simplified Chinese, OpenCC Traditional, Taiwan Standard with Taiwan idioms, or Hong Kong Traditional. Advanced character-variant and regional wording controls are available when you need them. Simplified output is not a complete reverse conversion of Taiwan-specific vocabulary.

Export the latest successful result as UTF-8 TXT, or copy and share it. Import and export handle one file up to 10 MiB, including UTF-8 with a BOM; exported files have no BOM. Line endings, blank lines, and Unicode text are preserved. Big5 and GBK files must first be saved as UTF-8. Batch files and files over 10 MiB are not supported, including with Pro.

Free users can complete 12 homepage conversions a day. Importing, exporting, and changing presets do not count. Lifetime Pro is a one-time purchase that removes the homepage daily limit and in-app recommendations. Restore purchases from Settings.

OpenCCman converts Chinese characters and regional wording with OpenCC. It does not translate Mandarin and Cantonese, generate pinyin, or offer a Japanese Shinjitai conversion mode. Open source under the MIT license: https://github.com/gewill/OpenCCman
whatsNew:
Four conversion presets and a single UTF-8 TXT import/export workflow, up to 10 MiB.
Switch between side-by-side and stacked panes on Mac and iPad. On iPhone, a compact Convert button leaves more room to read.
Cancel conversion or import without accepting late results. Purchase support is available in Settings.
